_about: F. C. S. Schiller (1864-1937), the Oxford pragmatist, raw IA OCR: Humanism, philosophical essays (London: Macmillan, 1903), Studies in Humanism, second edition (Macmillan, 1912) and Formal Logic, a scientific and social problem (Macmillan, 1912). Added in round am: Riddles of the Sphinx: a study in the philosophy of evolution, published as 'by a Troglodyte' (London: Swan Sonnenschein, 1891). US public domain. Not to be confused with schiller-essays (Friedrich Schiller). No uids minted.

fcs-schiller-riddles-of-the-sphinx-1891.author: Published anonymously as 'by a Troglodyte'; the Cornell copy carries a handwritten attribution to F. C. S. Schiller (OCR-garbled), and the title is his known first book (Swan Sonnenschein, 1891).
